returned: report: enter a protocol hold / completed / returned value
view: report: enter a protocol hold / completed / view
nextRefusal: report: enter a protocol hold / completed / next refusal position
nextAcceptance: report: enter a protocol hold / completed / next acceptance position
setupGrant: a refusal that leaves the setup grant unauthorized is a violation
refusalPosition: at another position, returned and retained alike
refusalExecution: naming another Execution, returned and retained alike
acceptingExit: a located exception in a scenario whose uninjected call does not accept
fired: a fault that did not fire, and a repeat in which one did
sameOperation: a run whose faulted operation is not the reference run's
quietRepeat: a fault that did not fire, and a repeat in which one did
callbackRan: a fault after the safety callback, in a run where it did not run
deliveredAt: a delivery row left absent, at the capability's freeze
takeoverWindowAt: the takeover window's receipt-only state, outside the clearing append
outcomeStepAt: an Outcome prefix, outside the apply window
outcomePrefix: a changed progress revision labelled as an Outcome apply fault by method name is a violation
applySequence: a declared apply sequence that no longer matches the source
applyModel: an Outcome decision the declared apply sequence cannot reproduce
referenceKind: an uninjected call that did not take its declared exit
referenceRefusal: a refusal that also revokes the grant
referenceUnnamed: a refusal naming no Execution that consumes a position
referenceUnchanged: an idempotent answer that changed the history
referenceReplay: an exact replay returning another decision
recoveryAnswer: a recovery answer that disagrees with the holds it left
takeoverAnswer: a takeover answer with another receipt
outcomeAnswer: an Outcome answer naming other Emissions
declaredExit: a scenario that does not take its declared exit
